replication.target_description: Replication 3: perceived Dettol effectiveness index (four 9-point items averaged), advertisement with five bottles versus one bottle; CloudResearch Approved Participants on MTurk.

n.sample_role: Participants in the target efficacy comparison; final analytic N unresolved.
n.exclusions: Footnote 2 describes duplicate MTurk IDs/IP addresses, actual/reported ID mismatches (unavailable for Replication 1), smartphone-sized screens, and failed attention checks. Final analytic counts and exclusion breakdown are not reproduced in the supplied text.
n.quote: We chose such a large sample because, after exclusions, we like to have at least 300 per cell for replications.

es.location: Results, paragraph beginning “If we want to be maximally optimistic”
es.quote: If we want to be maximally optimistic, we can highlight that the most supportive evidence came from Replication 3, the sample that should include only the ostensibly high-quality “CloudResearch Approved Participants”. But even here, the result was not significant, and the effect size (d = .10) is much smaller than in the original (d = .43).
